nodes.label: gMLP Architecture
nodes.author: Liu et al.
nodes.rationale: MLP-based architecture with gating for vision and NLP, using Spatial Gating Unit (SGU) for cross-token interactions without self-attention.

nodes.label: Spatial Gating Unit (SGU)
nodes.rationale: Linear spatial projection with multiplicative gating and channel splitting, enabling cross-token communication with near-zero initialization for training stability.

nodes.label: Channel Projection in gMLP
nodes.rationale: Linear projections along channel dimension similar to Transformer FFNs, with shapes 768×3072 and 3072×768 for BERT-base equivalent.

nodes.label: gMLP ImageNet Results
nodes.rationale: gMLP-B achieves 81.6% ImageNet top-1 accuracy, comparable to DeiT-B (81.8%) with 66% fewer parameters than MLP-Mixer-L/16.

nodes.label: gMLP BERT Pretraining
nodes.rationale: gMLP achieves parity with Transformers on MLM pretraining perplexity, learns Toeplitz-like spatial matrices representing shift invariance.

nodes.label: gMLP BERT Finetuning
nodes.rationale: Large gMLP achieves 87.7% MNLI and 82.1% SQuAD v2.0 F1, better than BERT-large; single-head attention addition improves performance further.

nodes.label: Learned Spatial Weight Patterns
nodes.rationale: Spatial projection matrices learn both locality and spatial invariance, effectively performing convolution with data-driven irregular kernel shapes.

nodes.label: gMLP Architecture
nodes.rationale: Gated MLP variant designed to replace multi-head self-attention in Transformers while maintaining competitive performance on BERT pretraining tasks.

nodes.label: Spatial Gating Unit (SGU)
nodes.rationale: Core component of gMLP that uses multiplicative gating with channel split to achieve best perplexity results.

nodes.label: BERT Pretraining Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Masked Language Modeling task used to evaluate gMLP vs Transformer baselines on perplexity and downstream finetuning.

nodes.label: Transformer with Relative Position Biases
nodes.rationale: Best-performing baseline using T5-style learnable relative position biases, achieving 4.26 perplexity.

nodes.label: MLP-Mixer
nodes.rationale: Vision model baseline that replaces self-attention with spatial MLP; adapted for MLM tasks for comparison.

nodes.label: aMLP (gMLP with Tiny Attention)
nodes.rationale: Hybrid model combining gMLP with single-head 64-d self-attention to improve cross-sentence alignment on tasks like MNLI.

nodes.label: Scaling Laws for gMLP and Transformers
nodes.rationale: Empirical observation that both architectures follow power-law scaling with model capacity, suggesting broad applicability of scaling laws.

nodes.label: GLUE Finetuning Tasks
nodes.rationale: Downstream evaluation tasks (SST-2, MNLI, SQuAD) used to assess transfer learning from pretraining.

nodes.label: Is Self-Attention Necessary?
nodes.rationale: Central research question: whether multi-head self-attention is essential for strong language model performance or if spatial gating suffices.
